 SAN ANTONIO — Northbound lanes of Loop 410 at New Sulphur Springs Road reopened Wednesday after an 18-wheeler struck a vehicle and caused a fuel spill.
 The crash happened at 11:16 a.m. One person was taken from the scene, and emergency crews responded to the spill.
